children: U.S. specialty apparel retailer's fiscal Q2 net sales rose 8.1% yr/yr
Comparable net sales increased 12.1%, marking fourth straight quarter of yr/yr growth
Net income improved to $8.4 mln, with fifth consecutive quarter of profit improvement
Tillys sees Q3 net sales of $150 mln-$155 mln and comparable sales growth of 10%-14%
Company expects Q3 net income of $2.2 mln to $3.7 mln, or $0.07 to $0.12 per share
Tillys expects Q3 SG&A expenses of $47 mln to $49 mln and product margins slightly improved
COMPARABLE SALES GROWTH - Higher comparable sales across physical stores and e-commerce supported revenue growth
PRODUCT MARGIN IMPROVEMENT - Improved product margins helped lift gross profit and operating income
OCCUPANCY COST REDUCTION - Lower occupancy costs from a reduced store count supported margins, partly offset by higher e-commerce shipping expenses
The one available analyst rating on the shares is "hold"
The average consensus recommendation for the apparel & accessories retailers peer group is "buy."
Wall Street's median 12-month price target for Tillys Inc is $5.50, about 38.9% above its September 1 closing price of $3.96
